normalized.result:
Thanks — this reads clearly and covers most of what I had in mind: saving links, tags, favorites, search, filters, editing, archiving, and delete-with-confirmation all look right, and I'm fine leaving sharing, imports, extensions, and page archiving for later.

One thing about the core saving experience doesn't match what I pictured, and it's important enough that I'd like it changed before we move on. When I save a link, I don't want to have to type the title myself every time — the whole point for me is that I paste a web address and the app fills in the page's title (and ideally its description/icon) automatically so saving is quick. The spec makes the title something I must enter and explicitly leaves automatic fetching out. I'd like saving a bookmark from just the address, with the title pulled in for me, to be part of this first release. I should of course still be able to edit that title afterward.

Everything else here is good enough for me. Please update that saving behavior and then we can go to the plan.
